title: A goblin shows HIT to the player when a die on it beats its hidden AC
source: A goblin that shows HIT when a die on it beats its AC
description: The goblin (circle radius 0.5 at [5, 5], so x 4.5..5.5) has ac 13 visible to the GM only and the hit formula. Aldric's d20 (a 1x1 rect) starts in a dice bag, so nothing is on the goblin; it is moved beside the goblin at [7, 5] (x 6.5..7.5, no overlap), then on top at [5.25, 5] (x 4.75..5.75, overlapping). After each board move its z is set to 1, above the goblin's 0, rather than relying on a default (FIXTURES §9). Unrolled, its total is 0 and hit stays false; a scripted 15 makes hit true. Moving the goblin away leaves the die behind and clears hit. Aldric can see hit but never ac.

expect.note: "`hit` is `false` with no die on the goblin" (FIXTURES §9): the die is in the bag, so on(this) is []; FORMULAS §6: the empty-list result of `any` is `false`.

"The viewer sees `hit`, not `ac`." FIXTURES §7: `cell_visible` is "the cell's own `cell_visibility` (default: the object's), intersected with the object's effective visibility"; hit has none of its own and the goblin is visible_to all.
DESIGN §4.4: "A public goblin can have public HP and GM-only AC."

steps.note: The die comes out of the bag and lands beside the goblin.

expect.note: FIXTURES §6: `move` "Drag an object to a destination"; FIXTURES §7: `placement` holds when "The object is on that board at that anchor". Footprint x 6.5..7.5 does not reach the goblin's 4.5..5.5.

steps.note: Set the die's z above the goblin's rather than relying on a default (FIXTURES §9).

expect.note: "`hit` is `false` ... with a die beside it" (FIXTURES §9). FORMULAS §6: `on(obj)` is "Objects whose footprint overlaps `obj` and that are above it in `z`"; the footprints do not overlap.

steps.note: The die is dragged onto the goblin.

expect.note: "the die is moved to a `position` whose footprint overlaps the goblin's" (FIXTURES §9): x 4.75..5.75 overlaps 4.5..5.5.

steps.note: Set z again after the move: the docs do not say what z a moved object gets (FIXTURES §9).

expect.note: "total = value + modifier" with both empty; FORMULAS §2.1: "`empty` in arithmetic is `0`".

"`on(this).where(...).total` is a list of numbers; `>= ac` broadcasts to a list of booleans; `any` reduces it." The die is on the goblin ("since the docs do not say what `z` an object gets when it lands on a board, a fixture sets it with a `set` step after the `move`"), but [0] >= 13 is [false].

steps.note: Aldric rolls the die on the goblin (scripted 15).

expect.note: "total = value + modifier": 15 + empty; FORMULAS §2.2: a roll result "acts as a number (its total) in arithmetic and comparison".

"`true` after a scripted roll of 15 on a die on top" (FIXTURES §9). "`on(this).where(...).total` is a list of numbers; `>= ac` broadcasts to a list of booleans; `any` reduces it." [15] >= 13 is [true].
"The viewer sees `hit`, not `ac`." FORMULAS §9: "The formula still computes and the viewer sees the result."
FORMULAS §8.1: logged with "the resolved values (the dice rolled, the id spawned)"; FIXTURES §7: "A `roll` matches a roll the group recorded and the cell it was written to."

steps.note: The goblin moves away; the die stays where it was.

expect.note: DESIGN §4.3: stacking "is not a container relationship, and moving a token does not carry the die sitting on it."
FORMULAS §6: `on(obj)` is "Objects whose footprint overlaps `obj` and that are above it in `z`"; nothing overlaps the goblin at [10, 10], so on(this) is [] and any([]) is false.
"ac: 13 (cell visible_to: gm)"; cell visibility does not depend on position.
